notes.title: Fuzzys Quest Updated To Version 1.0.0.32
notes.notes:
Fuzzys Quest has been updated to version 1.0.0.32

Changes
1) Graphics have been upgraded and now look clean and crisp.
2) Sound has been upgraded and no longer cuts out at random times
3) The controllability of Fuzzy has been improved
4) Mutated Mode is available once all mutators have been collected.
